'''Waterfiends''' are demonic elemental monsters made entirely out of water, which can be located in [[Ghorrock]] fortress during and after the completion of [[The Temple at Senntisten]]. They are slightly weaker than the versions found in the [[Ancient Cavern]]. Additionally, they are aggressive monsters, whereas their counterparts are not. They are also completely immune to fire spells.

They appear from inside various ice blocks when a [[heat globe]] is placed nearby. If the heat globe is subsequently removed, they will turn into [[Icefiend (Ghorrock)|icefiends]]. Likewise, the icefiends will turn back into waterfiends if the heat globe is placed back.

One unique, level 107 waterfiend can be found frozen within a large ice block on the lower floor, alongside a crate that contains 40 [[law rune]]s. Unlike the other waterfiends, it can be seen before it is unfrozen, and it cannot be turned into an icefiend. Although it has significantly more lifepoints than the other waterfiends, it is incapable of dealing damage with ranged attacks.

After the quest, the level 102 versions can be found in the bottom floor of the dungeon, with icefiends instead being found upstairs.

Compared to standard [[waterfiend]]s, Ghorrock waterfiends are slightly weaker with lower combat stats. They drop two charms at a time rather than one, but the drop rate is slightly lowered, which somewhat "balances" out the rate players can collect charms from them.
